content.icon.title: Icon content
content.icon.description: A canonical accessible icon authoring contract for documentation content.
limitations: Runtime bytes do not establish a safe authoring API.

ratio.label: Aspect ratio
ratio.description: Sets the shape of a block image.

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: Chooses whether to crop the image to its frame or show it in full.

gap.reason: The pinned runtime contains an icon element but no canonical authoring manifest.
gap.fallback: Use meaningful text or a Unicode symbol that remains understandable without decoration.
gap.admission_condition: Publish and pin a canonical icon authoring and accessibility contract, then add Docara schema, rendering, tests and documentation.

docara.card.title: Card
docara.card.description: Groups related Markdown content on a neutral bounded surface.
limitations: Nested Docara typed directives are not accepted.

variant.label: Appearance
variant.description: Selects a regular card or a composition block without its own border and padding.

values.default: Card with a surface, border and inner spacing

docara.columns.title: Columns
docara.columns.description: Arranges two to four source-ordered Markdown regions in a responsive SIMAI Framework grid.
limitations: The body must contain between two and four non-empty Markdown regions.
Regions must use an exact top-level --- separator surrounded by blank lines.
Nested Docara typed directives and Smart components are not accepted.
Column order always follows source order.

docara.cta.title: CTA link
docara.cta.description: Turns one safe Markdown link into a prominent native navigation action.
limitations: The body must contain exactly one safe Markdown link.
The result is a native link and does not claim an executable Smart action.

docara.features.title: Feature list
docara.features.description: Presents a short source-ordered list of product capabilities as a responsive grid.
limitations: The body must contain one flat unordered list with two to six items.
Nested lists, blocks and Docara directives are not accepted.

docara.hero.title: Hero
docara.hero.description: Explains the product, its value and the next step in the first landing viewport.
limitations: The body starts with one H1 and contains one or two description paragraphs.
One safe action link and one image with meaningful alternative text may follow the description.
Nested Docara typed directives and Smart components are not accepted.

docara.logos.title: Logos and members
docara.logos.description: Shows a compact responsive row of customers, partners or ecosystem products.
limitations: The body must contain one flat unordered list with two to twelve items.
An item may contain text, a safe link or an image with meaningful alternative text.

docara.promo.title: Promo
docara.promo.description: Closes a landing story with a concise next step, one prominent action and optional media.
limitations: The body starts with H2, contains one or two paragraphs and exactly one safe action link.
One safe decorative or informative image may follow the action.

docara.showcase.title: Product showcase
docara.showcase.description: Presents one large product proof image beside an explanation and optional action.
limitations: The body starts with H2, contains one or two paragraphs and ends with an image with meaningful alternative text.
One safe action link may precede the image.

docara.steps.title: Steps
docara.steps.description: Shows a short ordered sequence of actions.
limitations: The body must contain exactly one ordered Markdown list.
Nested Docara directives are not accepted.

view.label: View
view.description: Renders the sequence as a timeline or a list.

native.code.title: Code
native.code.description: Renders inline and fenced Markdown code; the pinned SIMAI Framework progressively adds one language-and-copy header, syntax highlighting and local overflow.
limitations: Without the pinned runtime the readable static pre/code fallback remains; fine-grained highlighting and line controls are not exposed.

native.code.enhanced.title: Configurable code
native.code.enhanced.description: Editor-grade code blocks with optional line numbers, highlighted lines, diff states and other author controls.
limitations: Fine-grained author controls are not part of the admitted Framework contract.

gap.reason: No admitted contract exposes optional line numbers, highlighted lines, diff states or other editor-grade controls.
gap.fallback: Use native.code; the pinned SIMAI Framework already provides language, copy, syntax highlighting and local overflow.
gap.admission_condition: Add the controls to SIMAI Framework with accessibility and fallback contracts, then admit them through deterministic projection, tests, documentation and browser acceptance.

native.headings_and_text.title: Headings and text
native.headings_and_text.description: Structures prose with headings, paragraphs, emphasis, strong text and strikethrough.
limitations: Raw HTML is not accepted as an authoring shortcut.

native.links_and_images.title: Links and images
native.links_and_images.description: Adds safe destinations and images with author-provided accessible text.
limitations: Unsafe link protocols are rejected.
Authors remain responsible for useful image alternative text.

ratio.label: Aspect ratio
ratio.description: Sets the shape of a block image.

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: Chooses whether to crop the image to its frame or show it in full.

native.lists_and_quotes.title: Lists and quotes
native.lists_and_quotes.description: Expresses ordered or unordered collections and semantic quotations.

author.label: Author
author.description: The name of the quoted author.

source.label: Source
source.description: The publication or other source name.

native.table.title: Markdown table
native.table.description: Presents small comparison or reference data in a scroll-safe semantic table.
limitations: This is a native Markdown table, not a structured DataView contract.

ui.alert.title: Alert
ui.alert.description: Reports a result, warning, or error as presentation-only content in portable Docara.
limitations: closable=true is not admitted by the current bounded runtime.
type=success is not admitted because the pinned Framework stylesheet renders its status icon transparent.
The id property is generated deterministically by Docara.
The Larena backend event bridge is intentionally omitted; portable Docara renders this component without backend handlers.

aria-label.label: Aria label
aria-label.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [aria-label].

closable.label: Closable
closable.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [closable].

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [icon].

supporting-text.label: Supporting text
supporting-text.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [supporting-text].

title.label: Title
title.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [title].

type.label: Tone
type.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [type].

variant.label: Variant
variant.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [variant].

ui.badge.title: Badge
ui.badge.description: A compact status label based on an exact upstream Smart manifest.
limitations: The upstream manifest exists, but Docara has not admitted it.

gap.reason: Docara has no bundled badge manifest, immutable lock record, projected assets or authoring tests.
gap.fallback: Use plain emphasized text that states the status directly.
gap.admission_condition: Bundle the exact upstream manifest, pin its provider revision and assets, forbid author-managed IDs, and pass schema, rendering, documentation and browser acceptance.

ui.button.title: Button
ui.button.description: Renders a bounded visual action control; portable Docara does not bind data, navigate, or execute an effect.
limitations: Docara renders the control but does not bind application data or execute an effect.
Navigation remains the job of a native link or docara.cta.
The Larena backend event bridge is intentionally omitted; portable Docara renders this component without backend handlers.

aria-label.label: Aria label
aria-label.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [aria-label].

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [disabled].

loading.label: Loading
loading.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [loading].

native-type.label: Native type
native-type.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [native-type].

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Exact manifest preset merged before explicit props.

radius.label: Corner radius
radius.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [radius].

scheme.label: Scheme
scheme.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [scheme].

size.label: Size
size.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [size].

text.label: Text
text.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [text].

type.label: Type
type.description: Optional author override for exact manifest property [type].

docara.alert.title: Alert
docara.alert.description: Reports important information, success, warning or failure using the shared SIMAI Framework treatment.
limitations: Never rely on color alone; the title and supporting text must carry the meaning.

docara.details.title: Details
docara.details.description: Hides optional supporting content until the reader chooses to open it.
limitations: Use the summary as a short, specific label; essential instructions must remain visible.

open.label: Initially open
open.description: Opens the disclosure when the page first loads.

docara.example.title: Example
docara.example.description: Shows the rendered result and its Markdown, HTML, CSS or JavaScript sources as tabs in one compact surface.
limitations: Use one source tab for Markdown. HTML may be accompanied by separate CSS and JavaScript; JavaScript runs only inside a sandboxed iframe.

label.label: Preview label
label.description: Sets a clear reader-facing label for the first tab.

docara.download.title: Download
docara.download.description: Presents a file download as a clear, accessible action with its supporting context.
limitations: The target must be a safe local or HTTP(S) URL and the link text must identify the file.

name.label: File name
name.description: Shows a clear reader-facing file name.

format.label: Format
format.description: Shows the file type or extension.

size.label: Size
size.description: Shows the file size before download.

checksum.label: Checksum
checksum.description: Helps readers verify the downloaded file.

action.label: Action
action.description: Downloads the file or opens it in the browser.

docara.embed.title: Embed
docara.embed.description: Places trusted external content in a responsive frame with a declared aspect ratio.
limitations: Only trusted HTTPS sources should be embedded; provide a meaningful title.

title.label: Accessible title
title.description: Names the embedded content for assistive technologies.

consent.label: Consent
consent.description: Controls whether external content loads only after consent.

docara.figure.title: Figure
docara.figure.description: Shows an image with alternative text, an optional caption and controlled proportions.
limitations: Alternative text is required; captions complement it but do not replace it.

ratio.label: Aspect ratio
ratio.description: Controls image proportions without distorting the source.

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: Controls whether the image fills the frame or remains fully visible.

docara.grid.title: Grid
docara.grid.description: Arranges cards and other blocks in a responsive grid without giving them new meaning.
limitations: Grid controls layout only; each child component remains responsible for its content and semantics.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Sets the maximum desktop column count.

gap.label: Gap
gap.description: Sets the Framework spacing between grid items.

docara.media.title: Media
docara.media.description: Pairs text with an illustration and supports both left and right visual emphasis.
limitations: The image requires meaningful alternative text and stacks before text becomes cramped.

side.label: Image side
side.description: Places the image to the left or right on wide screens.

docara.tree.title: File tree
docara.tree.description: Explains a nested file and directory structure with explicit hierarchy.
limitations: Use it for structure, not as application navigation; keep labels concise.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.description: Allows folders to be collapsed and expanded.

docara.badge.title: Badge
docara.badge.description: Adds a compact status, version or category label inside ordinary text and interface blocks.
limitations: Keep the label short and never use color as the only carrier of meaning.

type.label: Type
type.description: Selects the official SIMAI Framework badge treatment.

size.label: Size
size.description: Uses the Framework UI size scale.

docara.button.title: Button link
docara.button.description: Presents a navigation link as an inline action using the official Framework button contract.
limitations: Use it for navigation; form submission remains application-owned.

size.label: Size
size.description: Uses the Framework UI size scale.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Optional Material Symbols icon placed after the label.

docara.icon.title: Icon
docara.icon.description: Places a Material Symbols icon in text or composition with controlled family, weight and size.
limitations: Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technologies; meaningful icons require a label.

size.label: Size
size.description: Uses the Framework icon size scale.

weight.label: Weight
weight.description: Selects one of the useful documentation weights.

container.label: Container
container.description: Leaves the glyph bare or places it inside a square or circle.

variant.label: Container style
variant.description: Selects a bare, solid, tonal or outlined presentation.

scheme.label: Color scheme
scheme.description: Communicates the icon purpose through Framework colors.

label.label: Accessible label
label.description: Names a meaningful icon for assistive technologies.

docara.kbd.title: Keyboard input
docara.kbd.description: Marks a key or key combination inline with surrounding instructions.
limitations: Use inline inside a sentence; do not imitate a clickable button.

docara.banner.title: Banner
docara.banner.description: Shows a short page-level announcement without replacing the page hero.
limitations: Keep the message concise and use an alert when the information belongs to the document flow.

docara.diagram.title: Diagram
docara.diagram.description: Keeps a Mermaid diagram source readable and ready for deterministic rendering.
limitations: The portable build currently preserves an accessible source fallback; bundled Mermaid rendering is not yet part of the immutable runtime.

docara.html.title: Isolated HTML
docara.html.description: Renders explicitly trusted HTML in a sandbox isolated from the documentation page.
limitations: The sandbox intentionally blocks scripts and access to the parent page.

docara.math.title: Mathematical formula
docara.math.description: Keeps TeX source readable and ready for deterministic mathematical rendering.
limitations: The portable build currently preserves an accessible TeX fallback; bundled KaTeX rendering is not yet part of the immutable runtime.

label.label: Accessible label
label.description: Names the formula for assistive technologies.

docara.tabs.title: Tabs
docara.tabs.description: Switches between equivalent content views with keyboard and ARIA support.
limitations: Use tabs only for equivalent views; keep sequential instructions visible in normal document order.

native.footnotes_and_sources.title: Footnotes and sources
native.footnotes_and_sources.description: Adds source notes without interrupting the main text.
limitations: Use stable source labels and keep the cited destination available to readers.

ui.dataview.title: Data view
ui.dataview.description: A structured data and settings contract for interactive data presentation.
limitations: This is a different author job from a small Markdown table.

gap.reason: No bounded portable data source, settings, interaction and rendering contract is accepted for Docara.
gap.fallback: Use the supported native.table entry for small reference data.
gap.admission_condition: Define a separate portable data and settings contract with deterministic rendering, accessibility, tests and documentation.

ui.tabs.title: Tabs
ui.tabs.description: An accessible tab set with complete keyboard, focus and ARIA relationships.
limitations: The pinned Core and Smart sources do not provide the complete accepted accessibility contract.
Docara has no admitted tabs manifest or runtime lock record.

gap.reason: Keyboard focus movement, Home and End behaviour, stable tab-panel ARIA linkage and an admitted manifest are incomplete.
gap.fallback: Use headings and source-ordered sequential sections.
gap.admission_condition: Publish a canonical accessible tabs contract and manifest, pin a new immutable Framework pair and provider revision, then pass Docara schema, asset, rendering and browser acceptance.

docara.code.title: Code from file
docara.code.description: Includes a verified local file fragment without duplicating it in Markdown.
limitations: The path must remain inside the project; symlinks and files over 1 MiB are rejected.

lines.label: Lines
lines.description: One line or a range such as 1-8.

docara.backlinks.title: Backlinks
docara.backlinks.description: Lists pages that link to the current page.
limitations: The list is generated only from internal links in the current build.
